contract: Probe the supplied prefix as bytes and open it through the seekable and sequential adapters with the same read quantum as the reference AVIO callback.

Use the FFmpeg 9.0.2 decode profile. Score a padded prefix with av_probe_input_format3 and require a score above AVPROBE_SCORE_RETRY for bytes mode. Use av_probe_input_buffer2 for the adapters and verify the buffered prefix reads back byte for byte.

Fold kind 3, verdict (0 unknown, 1 FLAC, 2 MPEG audio, 3 ADTS, 4 AC-3 family, 5 Matroska, 6 ISO BMFF, 7 Ogg, 8 MPEG-TS), carrier width (bytes mode only) and replay presence. For an opened adapter also fold its pre-handoff consumed prefix length. The rewind and replay checks verify that the consumed bytes remain readable at the start.
